legal_units.title: Abetment of false return, etc.
legal_units.text: If a person abets or induces in any manner another person––
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 484 Abetment of false return, etc. If a person abets or induces in any manner another person––

legal_units.title: Abetment of false return, etc.
legal_units.text: to make and deliver an account or a statement or declaration relating to any income chargeable to tax which is false and which he either knows to be false or does not believe to be true; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 484 Abetment of false return, etc. If a person abets or induces in any manner another person–– Section 484(a): to make and deliver an account or a statement or declaration relating to any income chargeable to tax which is false and which he either knows to be false or does not believe to be true; or

legal_units.title: Abetment of false return, etc.
legal_units.text: to commit an offence under section 478(1),
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 484 Abetment of false return, etc. If a person abets or induces in any manner another person–– Section 484(b): to commit an offence under section 478(1),

legal_units.title: Abetment of false return, etc.
legal_units.text: with simple imprisonment for a term up to two years, or with fine, or with both, where the amount of tax, penalty or interest which would have been evaded, if the declaration, account or statement had been accepted as true, or which is wilfully attempted to be evaded, exceeds fifty lakh rupees; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 484 Abetment of false return, etc. If a person abets or induces in any manner another person–– Section 484(b): to commit an offence under section 478(1), Section 484(b)(i): with simple imprisonment for a term up to two years, or with fine, or with both, where the amount of tax, penalty or interest which would have been evaded, if the declaration, account or statement had been accepted as true, or which is wilfully attempted to be evaded, exceeds fifty lakh rupees; or

legal_units.title: Abetment of false return, etc.
legal_units.text: with simple imprisonment for a term up to six months, or with fine, or with both, where the amount of tax, penalty or interest which would have been evaded, if the declaration, account or statement had been accepted as true, or which is wilfully attempted to be evaded, exceeds ten lakh rupees but does not exceed fifty lakh rupees; or
